$comment: App-declared environment variables. Declare every variable this app reads beyond the platform-owned set; the Terp Studio deploy pipeline renders exactly the declared keys into a per-environment .app.env (see docker-compose.prod.yml). Names match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$. Mark write-only secrets with "format": "secret" — their values are sealed, never stored in plain records. A field this dialect does not have is REFUSED, because the deploy side drops what it does not recognise: "secret": true is the plausible mistake and it is not the field — it is dropped, and the value is then stored in plain records rather than sealed. format is one of secret | port | hostname | plain. A variable whose last word is SECRET, TOKEN, PASSWORD, PASSPHRASE, KEY, CREDENTIAL or CREDENTIALS must declare one: "format": "secret" to seal it, or "format": "plain" to record that it holds no credential. Platform-owned names (SECRET_KEY, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, DATABASE_URL, ENVIRONMENT, WEB_PORT, BACKEND_CORS_ORIGINS) are refused here. LIMITS, and the reader fails closed on the WHOLE file past any of them: at most 50 variables; type/title/description/format/group/resolvedBy are strings of at most 500 characters each; enum is at most 50 strings of at most 200 characters.
